use_case: Water quality anomaly detection: a machine learning model flags unusual patterns in analyzer data (chlorine residual, pH, turbidity, conductivity, flow, pressure) from both plants and 8 distribution monitoring stations
vendor_or_model: Model vendor (multivariate time-series anomaly detection model) deployed as a container in the company cloud tenant
build_or_buy: Buy (configured and baselined on 12 months of company historian data)
data_categories: Process and water quality data from the historian replica; no personal information
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: the 46,200 people served, through operator decisions)
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only. Alerts go to the Water Quality Supervisor and the control room; an operator must confirm with a grab sample or a second instrument before any process change or public notice decision. The model has no write path to SCADA and never suppresses SCADA alarms
applicable_laws: SDWA section 1433 RRA monitoring practices and ERP detection strategies (42 U.S.C. 300i-2(a)(1)(A)(iii), (b)(4)); 40 CFR Part 141 monitoring and public notice duties unchanged; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor accuracy claims)
status: Proposed (pilot since May 2026; not approved for production)

use_case: AMI leak and high-usage alerts: the AMI vendor's analytics flag continuous flow or unusual usage and send customers an alert
data_categories: Hourly meter interval data by account (customer data)
human_in_the_loop: Alerts are informational; no automatic shutoff, fee, or billing adjustment. Customer service reviews any leak adjustment request by hand under the tariff
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171 (customer data in the vendor system); FTC Act Section 5 (accuracy of customer-facing claims)

use_case: General-purpose generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft letters and summaries
data_categories: Risk of Restricted data (RRA, ERP, SCADA screenshots) or customer data being pasted
risk_tier: High (if Restricted or customer data entered)
applicable_laws: SDWA section 1433 information protection by company policy (POL-04, POL-05 4.8); Fla. Stat. 501.171 if customer personal information is entered
status: Proposed (prohibited for Restricted and Confidential data; an approved enterprise tool is under evaluation)
